layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped West circuit follows its complete northern return, central inner loop, eastern West-course hairpin and southern chicane. The operator separate-circuit plan identifies these West branches and a nominal two-mile course; the actual source route is 3234.3 m. The East circuit, long alternative straight, pit and paddock roads are excluded. The catalogue distance of 3385 m is retained without changing source coordinates; alignment date and direction remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3234.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance.
